equipmentArchitectures.name: Pilot-Scale Top-Spray Food Agglomerator & Granulator (150L, 50 kg Batch, 1.2 Bar Pressure-Shock Resistant)
equipmentArchitectures.classification: Commercial Pilot Kitchen & Specialty Food Agglomeration (NFPA 68, NFPA 652 & 3-A Sanitary 33-03)
equipmentArchitectures.nozzleArrangement: Multi-Head Pneumatic Top-Spray Two-Fluid Nozzle Array with External Mix Cap
equipmentArchitectures.filterType: Antistatic Stainless Wire Core Conductive Filter Sleeves with Reverse Pulse Jet (R ≤ 10 Ω)
equipmentArchitectures.explosionMitigation: Calibrated Rupture Disc Explosion Relief Vent (P_stat = 0.1 bar) Vented Outdoors via Flameless Quench Duct
equipmentArchitectures.metallurgy: 316L Stainless Steel Product Contact Surfaces (Ra ≤ 0.5 µm Mirror Polish, CIP Rotary Spray Balls)
equipmentArchitectures.description: Widely utilized in commercial pilot facilities, contract packaging sculleries, and functional beverage laboratories. Fluidizes fine food powders in an upward heated airstream while top-mounted two-fluid nozzles spray micro-droplet binder solutions, initiating liquid bridge coalescence into porous instantized granules.

equipmentArchitectures.name: Industrial Continuous Multi-Stage Vibro-Fluidizer (1,200 kg/hr Throughput, Integrated Fluid-Bed Drying & Cooling)
equipmentArchitectures.classification: High-Volume Commercial Dairy & Beverage Manufacturing (NFPA 69, NFPA 654, OSHA NEP Combustible Dust)
equipmentArchitectures.nozzleArrangement: Zoned Multi-Point Binary Spray Manifold (Agglomeration Zone 1, Conditioning Zone 2, Cooling Zone 3)
equipmentArchitectures.filterType: Continuous Rotary Plenum Cartridge Filters with PTFE Hydrophobic Anti-Static Membranes
equipmentArchitectures.explosionMitigation: Active NFPA 69 Chemical HRD Suppressors (Pressurized Sodium Bicarbonate Cannons Triggered in < 20 ms)
equipmentArchitectures.metallurgy: Food-Grade 304/316L Stainless Steel Construction with Sanitary Tri-Clamp Connections and Sanitary Airlocks
equipmentArchitectures.description: Continuous industrial vibro-fluidized bed engineered for high-throughput dairy whey, malted beverage powders, and soup concentrates. Combines low-frequency eccentric mechanical vibration with heated fluidizing air to handle sticky powders through the capillary moisture transition zone without bed quenching or agglomerate breakup.

equipmentArchitectures.name: Hygienic Dairy & Infant Formula Wurster Bottom-Spray Agglomerator (Closed-Loop Nitrogen-Inerted)
equipmentArchitectures.classification: Hygienic Infant Nutrition & Pharmaceutical Food Powder (ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU & EHEDG Doc 8)
equipmentArchitectures.nozzleArrangement: Bottom-Mounted Wurster Partition Column with Precision Pneumatic High-Velocity Atomizer
equipmentArchitectures.filterType: Double-Chamber Alternating Metal Fiber Candle Filters (Conductive Inconel 625 Mesh, R ≤ 1 Ω)
equipmentArchitectures.explosionMitigation: Full NFPA 69 / ATEX Closed-Loop Nitrogen Blanketing (O2 < 7.5% LOC) & 10-Bar Explosion-Containment Vessel
equipmentArchitectures.metallurgy: High-Purity 316L Vacuum-Degassed Stainless Steel (Ra ≤ 0.3 µm, Electro-Polished, Self-Draining CIP Architecture)
equipmentArchitectures.description: Ultra-hygienic precision bottom-spray coater engineered for infant nutritional formula, microencapsulated probiotic vitamins, and hydrolysates. Recirculates nitrogen gas below the limiting oxygen concentration (LOC), completely eliminating the possibility of dust deflagration while Wurster draft tubes generate tight, uniform particle distribution.

equipmentArchitectures.name: Legacy Unvented Food Powder Agglomeration Tower (Thin Sheet-Metal, Degraded Grounding, Severe Deflagration Risk)
equipmentArchitectures.classification: Compromised Legacy Facility (Catastrophic Combustible Dust Overpressure & Static Spark Hazard)
equipmentArchitectures.nozzleArrangement: Single Fixed Hydraulic / Low-Pressure Air Atomizing Nozzle (Coarse Droplets, High Localized Wetting)
equipmentArchitectures.filterType: Woven Cotton / Polyester Cloth Filter Bags (Non-Conductive, Degraded Static Continuity R > 500 Ω)
equipmentArchitectures.explosionMitigation: None / Blind Flanged Vent Port (No Certified Rupture Panels, No Suppression Cannons, No Isolation Dampers)
equipmentArchitectures.metallurgy: Pitted 304 Carbon-Steel Clad Exterior with Flaking Paint, Crevices, and Corroded Grounding Straps
equipmentArchitectures.description: Aging food powder batch tower operating with compromised electrostatic safety. Non-conductive filter sleeves accumulate lethal electrostatic charges (up to 25 kV), while absence of certified explosion venting or isolation valves means any internal dust deflagration will result in catastrophic vessel rupture and secondary building explosion.

foodPowderSubstrates.name: Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate (WPI 90, Ultra-Fine Cohesive Powder)
foodPowderSubstrates.geldartClassification: Group A / C (Cohesive, Aeratable with Agglomeration Tendency)
foodPowderSubstrates.description: Ultra-fine hydrolyzed whey protein powder with poor raw wettability and a tendency to form stubborn surface gelatinous lumps when exposed to cold liquids. Extremely cohesive due to van der Waals forces; requires controlled liquid bridging to form porous instant granules with rapid cold-water dispersion (<12s).

foodPowderSubstrates.name: Instant Maltodextrin & Soluble Corn Starch Mix (Carbohydrate Matrix)
foodPowderSubstrates.description: Widely used functional bulking carrier and beverage base. Features intermediate particle diameter and smooth spherical geometry. Fluidizes smoothly with minimal elutriation loss; spray agglomeration rapidly dissolves surface amorphous sugars, bonding particles into highly soluble granular clusters.

foodPowderSubstrates.name: High-Fat Whole Milk Powder (26% Free Fat, Dairy Infant Formulation Base)
foodPowderSubstrates.geldartClassification: Group B (Easily Sand-Fluidized, Prone to Thermoplastic Sticking)
foodPowderSubstrates.description: Fat-rich dairy powder prone to thermoplastic stickiness at processing temperatures above 48°C. Surface fat inhibits hydrophilic water penetration; spray agglomeration with lecithin-enriched binders coats particles, transforming hydrophobic fat boundaries into instant wetting interfaces.

foodPowderSubstrates.name: Alkalized High-Fat Cocoa & Confectionery Sugar Blend (Microfine Dark Cocoa)
foodPowderSubstrates.geldartClassification: Group C (Highly Cohesive, Channelling Risk, High Deflagration Sensitivity)
foodPowderSubstrates.description: Very fine, lipid-containing cocoa powder blended with pulverized sugar. Exhibits pronounced cohesive channeling and rat-holing during fluidization. Due to sub-30 µm dust fines and low MIE (12 mJ), it represents a severe combustible dust deflagration risk, requiring strict electrostatic dissipation.

atomizingBinderSolutions.name: Aqueous Low-DE Maltodextrin Solution (15% Solids, Clean-Label Binder)
atomizingBinderSolutions.description: Industry-standard clean-label carbohydrate binder solution. Provides ideal droplet atomization with moderate viscosity, creating durable crystalline-amorphous solid bridges between colliding powder particles without sticky agglomerate wall fouling.

atomizingBinderSolutions.name: Soy / Sunflower Lecithin Phospholipid Emulsion (10% Lecithin, Hydrophilic Wetting Agent)
atomizingBinderSolutions.description: Essential amphiphilic surfactant formulation applied to fatty dairy and protein powders. Depresses droplet surface tension (31.5 mN/m) for ultra-fine atomization, depositing monomolecular phospholipid monolayers that dramatically accelerate instant sinkability in cold liquids.

atomizingBinderSolutions.name: Purified Demineralized Water (Autogenous Sugar/Protein Surface Dissolution)
atomizingBinderSolutions.description: Used when the raw food powder contains sufficient intrinsic soluble carbohydrates or proteins to form autogenous liquid bridges upon micro-droplet contact. Requires high pneumatic atomization pressure (3.5+ bar) to overcome high water surface tension and prevent localized bed wetting.

atomizingBinderSolutions.name: Concentrated Sucrose & Hydrolyzed Gelatin Solution (25% Solids, High-Tack Binder)
atomizingBinderSolutions.description: High-viscosity polymer binder for heavy granular mixes, nutritional tablets, and chewable bases. High tack strength produces exceptionally robust agglomerates, but elevated viscosity shifts droplet size coarser, requiring elevated atomizing air ratios to avoid nozzle bearding.

safetyStandards.title: Standard on the Fundamentals of Combustible Dust
safetyStandards.mandate: Requires completion of a comprehensive Dust Hazard Analysis (DHA), identification of Kst/Pmax/MIE indices, and verified electrostatic bonding continuity for all food processing dust collectors and fluidized beds.

safetyStandards.title: Standard on Explosion Protection by Deflagration Venting
safetyStandards.mandate: Calculates required relief rupture panel surface area (Av) based on vessel volume (V), reduced pressure limit (Pred), relief opening pressure (Pstat), and vent duct inertia to prevent vessel bursting.

safetyStandards.title: Standard on Explosion Prevention Systems
safetyStandards.mandate: Governs deflagration prevention via limiting oxygen concentration (LOC) inert gas padding, active high-rate discharge (HRD) chemical suppression barriers, and mechanical fast-acting shutoff valves.

safetyStandards.title: Equipment Intended for Use in Potentially Explosive Atmospheres
safetyStandards.mandate: Classifies internal fluidized bed expansion chamber as Zone 20 (permanent explosive dust cloud) requiring Category 1D certified instrumentation, intrinsically safe sensors, and zero ignition potential.

safetyStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Fluidized Bed Dryers and Agglomerators
safetyStandards.mandate: Dictates all food product contact surfaces must have Ra ≤ 0.8 µm (0.4 µm for baby foods), continuous ground weld seams free of pits or cracks, and self-draining clean-in-place (CIP) spray coverage.
